series.name: Inflation
series.subtitle: All-items CPI · annual change
series.explanation: Year-over-year change in the unadjusted all-items Consumer Price Index for Canada, calculated against the same month one year earlier. Not your household inflation rate.

series.name: Unemployment
series.subtitle: Canada · age 15+ · seasonally adjusted
series.explanation: Unemployed people as a percentage of the labour force, total gender, ages 15 and over, seasonally adjusted.

series.name: Policy rate
series.subtitle: Target for the overnight rate
series.explanation: Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate. This is not a retail mortgage or savings rate.

series.name: Canadian dollar
series.subtitle: US dollars for C$1
series.explanation: Reciprocal of the Bank of Canada daily USD/CAD observation. Indicative daily rate, not an executable quote or the rate your bank will offer.

series.name: 10-year bond yield
series.subtitle: Government of Canada benchmark
series.explanation: Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond yield. Yield is not the bond price and changes between observations.

series.name: Housing starts
series.subtitle: Canada · seasonally adjusted annual rate
series.explanation: CMHC housing starts, all areas, expressed at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. This is an annualized pace, not units actually started during the month or completed homes.
